polozky.nadpis: GISCorps Seeks Executive Director to Build on Two Decades of Humanitarian Service
polozky.perex: The volunteer-driven geospatial organization is recruiting its first paid executive director as founder Shoreh Elhami prepares for a leadership transition.
polozky.telo: The volunteer-driven geospatial organization is recruiting its first paid executive director as founder Shoreh Elhami prepares for a leadership transition. GISCorps, the humanitarian GIS volunteer program of the Geospatial Professional Network (GPN), is seeking its first paid executive director to help guide the organization into its next chapter. Founded in 2003 by GIS professional Shoreh Elhami, GISCorps connects geospatial expertise with organizations responding to disasters, humanitarian emergencies, and other challenges around the world. Its volunteers have supported projects ranging from earthquake and hurricane response to disease mapping, nonprofit data development, and GIS training.
